story: A break went clear early and built a lead of up to five minutes. Red Bull–BORA–hansgrohe controlled the peloton and gradually reduced the gap. On the final climb, the team set a high pace, leaving only Lipowitz, Pellizzari and Omrzel at the front. Omrzel was dropped before Lipowitz also distanced his teammate. Lipowitz crested the climb 30 seconds clear, Pellizzari returned on the descent. The Red Bull duo rode together to the finish, where Lipowitz took the win.
